triage.summary: Checkout API 5xx error rate at 37% due to DB connection exhaustion after concurrency increase in checkout-v42 deploy.
triage.reason: Customer-facing checkout errors with 37% 5xx rate impacting revenue; recent deploy raised concurrency leading to DB pool exhaustion, needs immediate Diagnosis.

diagnosis.root_cause: Increased worker concurrency from 8 to 24 in checkout-v42 deploy exhausted DB connection pool (100% used), causing OperationalError on new connections.
cited_evidence: logs[0]: psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved / too many connections
diagnosis.reasoning: Deploy at 14:02 UTC raised concurrency (8\u219224), 6 min later alert fired; db_connections_used_pct hit 100%, p99_latency_ms rose to 4100 ms, and logs show connection exhaustion errors exactly matching the 37% 5xx rate. All signals align on the concurrency change as the trigger.

risky.action: Roll back checkout deployment to v41
risky.rationale: Reverts worker concurrency from 24 back to 8, directly relieving DB connection pool exhaustion caused by the v42 change.

approval.note: Operator approved risky actions via UI

verification.note: This is a projected post-remediation check over simulated telemetry, not a live re-measurement.

postmortem.summary: Checkout API experienced a SEV-1 incident with 5xx error rate reaching 37% due to DB connection pool exhaustion following the checkout-v42 deployment that increased worker concurrency from 8 to 24. The issue was diagnosed from deploy logs, metrics showing 100% DB connections used, and psycopg2.OperationalError entries. Risky rollback to v41 was approved and executed, restoring error rate to 0.01.
timeline: 14:02 UTC: deploy-bot: checkout-v42 rolled out to prod, worker concurrency raised 8 -> 24
14:08 UTC: Alert fired - Checkout API 5xx error rate at 37% (threshold 5%) for 4 minutes
14:08 UTC: metrics.db_connections_used_pct hit 100%, p99_latency_ms rose to 4100 ms
14:08 UTC: logs show psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved / too many connections and db pool acquire timeout after 3000ms
postmortem.root_cause: Increased worker concurrency from 8 to 24 in checkout-v42 deploy exhausted DB connection pool (100% used), causing OperationalError on new connections.
actions_taken: Roll back checkout deployment to v41
follow_ups: Add pre-deploy validation to check DB connection pool capacity against proposed worker concurrency changes
Implement automated canary analysis for concurrency-related metrics before full rollout
Increase DB connection pool size or introduce connection pooling middleware as capacity buffer
